changes.to: No maker page could be found. EncoSmart's own site (encosmart.com) presents kitchen automation - the LAVA frying station and the Encobot Tornado and Linn - and does not list Nico; the robot was announced 16 Apr 2026 at the Canton Fair by Ninebot Commercial (九号商用) with EncoSmart, and the only spec text is a press release republished by venues and Korean trade press: 165 cm, under 55 kg, 7-DoF food-grade arms with biomimetic hands, 8-10 h in a hybrid move/standby mode, no-track navigation. Those numbers are press-release claims without a maker page behind them, so no field is filled.
A food-service humanoid announced by Ninebot Commercial with EncoSmart for restaurant and hotel work; only press-release material exists, with no maker product page.
